name: aligned_linear_cal
description: Landscape printable calendar with vertical weekend alignment.

scripts.build:saconsumer: tsc && vite build --config vite.config.saconsumer.ts && mv dist/index.html dist/calendar-core.php
scripts.deploy: npm run build:saconsumer && rm -rf deploy && mkdir deploy && cp claim_work/*.php claim_work/*.txt claim_work/*.ico deploy/ && cp -r dist/* deploy/
scripts.deploy:free: npm run build:free && rm -rf deploy && mkdir deploy && cp claim_work/favicon.ico deploy/ && cp -r dist/* deploy/
